description: Captures the deterministic player inventory and state-snapshot delta when the scripted forward-movement burst (02-021) collides with the E1M1 starting armor pickup. Verifies the vanilla armor pickup grants armorpoints += 100, armortype = 2 (mega), removes the mobj from the world thinker list, and increments item_count by 1. Entries empty pending external reference run.
captureMethod: From 02-020 spawn, drive forward 35 tics; capture state at the pickup-collision tic and pickup + 1.
